data_objects.name: genomic_window_phylogenies
data_objects.meaning: Ordered genomic windows with interval coordinates, SNP and sample-coverage counts, and a serialized phylogenetic tree for each window.
data_objects.notes: Tree strings use Newick-like parenthesized syntax with named tips, branch lengths, and numeric internal-node annotations.

variables.name: Unnamed: 0
variables.meaning: Sequential row index aligned with ascending genomic-window order.

variables.name: start
variables.meaning: Start coordinate of the genomic window.

variables.name: end
variables.meaning: End coordinate of the genomic window.

variables.name: nsnps
variables.meaning: Number of single-nucleotide polymorphisms represented in the window.

variables.name: nsamplecov
variables.meaning: Number of samples contributing coverage to the window.

variables.name: tree
variables.meaning: Serialized phylogenetic tree associated with the genomic window.

structure.description: Rows form fixed-width, regularly stepped, overlapping windows ordered by start coordinate; each tree and pair of counts belongs to that row's interval.
Unnamed: 0 is a unique sequential row index, while the genomic interval is represented by the start and end fields.

uncertainties: The genomic reference, coordinate origin, and end-coordinate inclusivity convention are not stated.
The units and interpretation of tree branch lengths and internal numeric annotations are not documented.
annotation_notes: Only the declared train.csv and its neutral packet were used as evidence.
